Default unchecked preserves ordinary hints; checked shows object kind/name-or-stable-identity/current readable state. No requirement to press keyboard Alt. Do not copy the whole Legacy experiments catalog.

requirements.requirement: Information comes from each owning feature's existing public read-only projection. Node/Port/Edge use current scoped document/context snapshots already supplied; Widget uses authorized read binding; Panel uses its public identity/presentation/exportable UI state without leaking live authority. UI-only controls may identify their feature/action and availability without fabricating a model object.

Mark committed values, unfinished field drafts and UI-only state distinctly when those are exposed. Unavailable data says 未提供 rather than traversing private internals or changing core APIs just to expose it.

Keep hover concise. Provide an accessible explicit way to expand long data in a bounded wrapping/scrolling read-only view, with Close/Escape and safe focus return. Avoid a large tooltip obscuring work. Normal accessible labels and operation instructions remain available; mode switching changes presentation only.

No model mutation, no duplicate synchronized object-state store, no serialization of DOM/functions/tokens/live leases, no general object reflection framework and no persisted diagnostic snapshots. Local experimental preference follows accepted Preferences isolation from graph/layout/Graph History and visible failure behavior; document default/storage choice.

Avoid whole-Graph capture or serialization on every pointermove. Reuse current feature projection and compute bounded target detail on demand; prove with instrumented counts or equivalent meaningful evidence.

Delete, selection/target change, Stage/occurrence change, document replacement/reload, same-ID reuse, hide/move/remount/dispose and late callbacks must not leave stale object details or write paths. Cancel the view or show unavailable as appropriate.

Hover does not select, focus, begin gestures, connect, edit, dirty the graph or add History. Checkbox interaction is guarded during unfinished gestures per accepted experiments policy and does not discard focused drafts/IME state.
Retain the Owner's selection geometry and white-with-alpha text direction in newly introduced UI. Existing typed socket/wire coloring policy is not removed.
